author: attome-callintel (D22-T9)
description: D22-T9: stored queries over the nightly call trend aggregates: tracker hits by week, staff talk share and scorecard results by team.
name: attome-callintel-trends

definition.name: Call trackers by week
definition.sql: SELECT date_trunc('week', t.day) AS week, t.tracker_ref, SUM(t.value) AS hits FROM call_daily_aggregate t WHERE t.metric = 'tracker_hits' AND t.is_active IS NOT FALSE GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

definition.name: Call talk share by team
definition.sql: SELECT t.team_ref, date_trunc('week', t.day) AS week, AVG(t.value) AS staff_talk_share FROM call_daily_aggregate t WHERE t.metric = 'staff_talk_share' AND t.is_active IS NOT FALSE GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2, 1

definition.name: Call scorecard results by team
definition.sql: SELECT t.team_ref, date_trunc('week', t.day) AS week, AVG(t.value) AS yes_rate FROM call_daily_aggregate t WHERE t.metric = 'scorecard_yes_rate' AND t.is_active IS NOT FALSE GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2, 1

title: Platform definitions: attome-callintel-trends
